title: Replicating Activation Steering for Sycophancy Suppression on DeepSeek-R1-8B

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: DeepSeek-R1-8B and Llama-3.1-8B run on medium compute. Activation steering with mean-response probes has published implementations. SycoBench is standard.
